tldr: Mercury in the 6th house routes the mind and voice through rhythm and service.
body: With Mercury in the 6th house, thinking, speech, learning, writing, business, and the way the mind makes connections move through daily work, health, habits, service, maintenance, and labor. This makes how your days are built and whether your routine supports the life you say you want a central part of the life. Used consciously, this placement can become language, strategy, adaptability, problem-solving, and the ability to name what is happening. Left unconscious, it can become overthinking, nervous loops, clever avoidance, or talking around the feeling instead of entering it.
gift: language, strategy, adaptability, problem-solving, and the ability to name what is happening expressed through rhythm and service.
challenge: overthinking, nervous loops, clever avoidance, or talking around the feeling instead of entering it concentrated in rhythm and service.
note: Authored from approved project planet-through-house material; source file was not copied into the repository.
